Evidence Summary: Signzy's Agentic CKYC Platform and Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) engine automate CKYC search, data validation, correction, image optimization, sensitive ID masking, and straight-through processing (STP) for customer onboarding and risk assessment without manual intervention when pre-set validation rules are met.
Evaluation Notes: Focuses on autonomous execution within regulatory identity verification, CKYC/CERSAI submission, and compliance rule domains.

Evidence Summary: The platform utilizes an AI-based Rule and Decision Engine capable of evaluating up to 7 levels of conditional rules and risk scoring simultaneously for de-duplication, name screening/grading, fraud detection, and verification pathways.
Evaluation Notes: Demonstrates automated multi-level deterministic and ML-driven decision logic rather than open-ended LLM chain-of-thought planning.

Evidence Summary: Signzy's No-Code API Orchestrator (NCO / Signzy GO) supports multi-stage journeys with drag-and-drop workflow configuration, conditional routing, API sequencing (sequential or parallel), checkpoints, and customized verification, validation, AI, and bank-specific business rules.
Evaluation Notes: Features visual drag-and-drop workflow authoring for complex, cross-channel onboarding and verification journeys.

Evidence Summary: The Orchestrator persists application state, customer data, and API response payloads at journey checkpoints using unique customer/journey identifiers, maintaining back-office audit trails and session context across multi-step flows and transaction monitoring streams.
Evaluation Notes: Manages session state and lifecycle audit records; public documentation does not establish a general-purpose, persistent agent conversational memory service.

Evidence Summary: The platform monitors model drift and applies ongoing risk scoring and rule calibration to optimize compliance, fraud detection, and transaction monitoring algorithms over time.
Evaluation Notes: Focuses on operational model performance monitoring and rule calibration; no official evidence of autonomous continual self-training or parameter adaptation from live interactions.
No sufficient official public documentation was found demonstrating autonomous multi-agent collaboration, delegation frameworks, or inter-agent protocols.

Evidence Summary: Signzy GO provides a drag-and-drop no-code graphical platform enabling business and compliance teams to design onboarding journeys, set up multi-level decision rules, configure API sequencing, and integrate modular verification components without writing code.
Evaluation Notes: Confirms visual, no-code workflow and journey creation; does not establish an open-ended general-purpose agent builder.
Signzy utilizes proprietary AI/ML, OCR, and computer vision models for verification; no public documentation exists for general foundation model switching or BYOLLM frameworks.

Evidence Summary: Signzy provides an API Self-Service Portal featuring a secure sandbox environment, plug-and-play REST APIs, credential management, comprehensive documentation, pre-built frontend widgets, and no-code API onboarding tools.
Evaluation Notes: Streamlines integration and testing through self-service sandboxes, prebuilt widgets, and reusable modular components.

Evidence Summary: Signzy offers an aggregated marketplace of over 200–240 REST API microservices, embeddable widgets, and a no-code API Orchestrator that handles data mapping, transformations, sequencing, retries, rate limiting, and webhooks across core banking and partner systems (e.g., India Stack, biometrics, databases).
Evaluation Notes: Comprehensive API coverage for identity verification, document extraction, AML/KYC checks, and external system connectivity.

Evidence Summary: Signzy provides cloud SaaS delivery, preproduction/production HTTPS API environments, and cloud-native hosting with support for regional data localization and data residency compliance across global jurisdictions.
Evaluation Notes: Supports hosted cloud-native API access and jurisdiction-specific residency; broad on-premises or customer-managed self-hosting is not sufficiently documented.

Evidence Summary: Integrates human-in-the-loop workflows across products, including a back-office case management console, role-based escalation queues for ambiguous cases, assisted Video KYC (V-CIP) with human verification, and manual review of probable face matches before CKYC submission.
Evaluation Notes: Enables explicit operator review and manual sign-off on flagged, ambiguous, or high-risk verification cases.

Evidence Summary: Provides operational traceability through back-office activity logs, API consumption statistics, transaction-level rule evaluation status breakdowns (violations, evaluation timings), MIS reporting, and Video KYC call analytics dashboards.
Evaluation Notes: Delivers robust operational logging, status tracking, and audit trails; formal AI reasoning explainability is not publicly documented.

Evidence Summary: Certified ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 compliant, supporting 256-bit encryption (at rest and in transit), HTTPS, mTLS, OAuth 2.0, API key authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), 24/7 security monitoring, and privacy audit trails.
Evaluation Notes: Strict adherence to financial-grade security, enterprise access management, and global regulatory compliance standards.

Evidence Summary: Designed for high-throughput enterprise scale, supporting over 1 million queries per hour, more than 10 million monthly onboardings/verifications at a 99% success rate, and over 300,000 monthly Video KYC calls for major banking clients.
Source Type: Customer case studies and implementation stories
Evaluation Notes: Proven high-concurrency scalability in Tier-1 banking and fintech production deployments.

Evidence Summary: Purpose-built for financial services, banking, NBFCs, fintech, insurance, lending, wealth management, and crypto due diligence across 150+ countries, with specialized workflows for KYC, KYB, AML, CKYC, and V-CIP.
Evaluation Notes: Deep domain specializations mapped directly to global identity verification and regulatory compliance frameworks.

Evidence Summary: Implementations deliver substantial operational gains, including a 90% reduction in turnaround time, a 70% decrease in manual reviews, a 75% drop in operational costs, a 66% reduction in customer drop-off, a 3x increase in successful onboardings, and deployment in 3–4 weeks.
Source Type: Customer case studies and implementation stories
Evaluation Notes: Strong customer and platform performance metrics; figures are vendor- and customer-reported rather than independently audited ROI studies.
